## Core principle

The missing layer must turn the existing authority FSM into an actual zero-LLM daemon-side statistical execution path:

PREPARED_UNREGISTERED -> machine proposal -> machine-recomputed PRECONDITIONS_PASS -> delegated redemption -> HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED -> APPLIED -> daemon-owned label-gated execution -> durable write-once seal -> only status/hash escapes to orchestrator.

No client-supplied scientific result may ever be accepted for sealing.

## Preferred command surface

Public daemon/client commands:
- `preconditions-evaluate --proposal-id ...`
- `trial-execute --proposal-id ...`
- optional read-only `trial-status --proposal-id ...`

A public `seal-result` accepting result JSON is not desired. The seal writer should be daemon-internal. If exposed at all, it may accept only a daemon-owned attempt/result token, never caller-provided statistics.

The old digest-echo path for `PRECONDITIONS_PASS` must not remain a bypass for statistical trials.

Persist a canonical outcome-free evidence object and bind its SHA-256 to PRECONDITIONS_PASS. It must contain proposal identity, stage-relevant C/D/root/A/B state, recomputed frozen hashes, evaluator/runtime observations, exact matrix row IDs and PASS/FAIL, PIT/data availability facts required by the frozen matrix, T1-first facts, and for W1 the sealed-T1 binding, non-VOID result class, 174/list/grammar/enumerator/order checks, and signed resource-policy binding. No new threshold.

Do not hold a DB write lock while hashing large files. Compute observations without label access, then use a short BEGIN IMMEDIATE section to revalidate canonical DB state and commit the evidence+transition. Use a post-cutover k3-nonwritable scientific-root location so filesystem observations cannot be agent-mutated.

Fable staging is evidence, not the future production trust root. Build an admin-installed, k3-nonwritable canonical 20-object scientific-root bundle or equally strong mapping. T1: verify APPLIED -> exactly one logical trial -> RUNNING attempt -> startup hashes -> pre-outcome PIT/features/groups/weights -> APPLIED recheck -> metadata-only label-access marker -> LabelGate -> permitted outcomes -> frozen T1 artifact -> durable seal -> attempt COMPLETE + seal binding -> return only IDs/hash/result-state enum.

1. Compute canonical result bytes in daemon memory.
2. Compute SHA-256.
